title: Companies Requiring R and Data Visualization

scout_postings.sql: SELECT * FROM scout_postings WHERE lower(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%r%' AND (lower(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%' OR lower(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualisation%')
scout_postings.title: Postings mentioning R and data visualization

querychat_viz_widgets.ggsql:
WITH company_counts AS (
  SELECT company, COUNT(*) AS postings
  FROM scout_postings
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%r%'
    AND (lower(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%'
         OR lower(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualisation%')
    AND company IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY company
  ORDER BY postings DESC, company
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT company, postings
FROM company_counts
VISUALISE company AS y, postings AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Postings requiring R and data visualization', y => 'Company'
